title: A highly-sensitive graphene-based immunoassay procedure for the detection of human lipocalin-2
protocol: Put 100 μL of 1% (w/v) KOH into the wells of a 96-well MTP.
Incubate the KOH-treated MTP for 5 min at 37°C.
Wash the MTP with 300 μL of UPW five times.
Mix 1 mg of GNPs with 1 mL of 0.25% (v/v) APTES and disperse in an ultrasonic bath for 1 h.
Incubate the KOH-treated MTP with 100 μL of GNPs in 0.25% APTES for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash the GNPs-functionalized wells extensively with UPW as described in step 1.
Mix 990 μL of anti-LCN2 capture antibody (2 µg/mL) with 10 μL of EDC (4 mg/mL).
Incubate the mixture for 15 min at 37°C.
Put 100 µL of EDC-activated anti-LCN2 antibody into the GNPs-functionalized wells.
Incubate the wells for 1 h at 37°C.
Wash the wells with 400 μL of PBST five times.
Block antibody-bound wells with 400 μL of 1% \(w/v) BSA for 30 min at 37°C.
Wash the blocked wells extensively with PBST.
Add 100 µL of varying LCN2 concentrations (0.6-5120 pg/mL) to different BSA-blocked wells.
Incubate the wells containing LCN2 for 1 h at 37°C and wash extensively with PBST.
Add 100 μL of biotinylated anti-LCN2 antibody to each well containing captured LCN2.
Incubate the wells for 1 h at 37°C and wash extensively with PBS.
Add 100 µL of SA-HRP conjugate to the wells treated with biotinylated anti-LCN2 antibody.
Incubate the wells for 20 min at 37°C and wash extensively with PBST.
Add 100 μL of TMB-H2O2 mixture to the wells of MTP and incubate at RT for 20 min to develop color.
Stop the enzyme-substrate reaction by adding 50 µL of 2 N H2SO4 to each well.
Measure the absorbance at a primary wavelength of 450 nm and secondary wavelength of 540 nm in the Tecan MTP reader.
Determine the absorbance after 5 minutes of stopping the enzyme substrate reaction.
